summary: Price at the gate: $50 midweek, $55 Saturday ($54.50/$59.65 with Campspot fees). Long-stay tests pass (28/130 nightly). 50A added, 130 sites, pull-through, store/WiFi; lakefront not shown for nightly sites.
flags: PRICE GATE, for AWH: cheapest real RV night is $50 midweek (2026-07-14), at the line, no gateway within 40 km. With Campspot's fees it's $54.50 all-in, and a July Saturday is $55 base, $59.65 all-in. I read the fees as booking fees, not a nightly rate, so it passes at the line, but it's the borderline kind: Google 4.4 (200) if a tiebreaker is wanted. RV Life $$$.

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) above. (2) passes: Campspot sells one night, weekday and Saturday. (3) no minimum seen. (4) passes: 28 listed nightly (26 RV + 2 tent) of 130 = 21.5%. (5) no sign of a home community, though imagery shows dense rows and the site offers seasonal $2,350 and monthly $650.
PRESENCE passes: own site, phone 419-641-3782, Campspot. Good Sam status not established.

WATERFRONT LEAD: stored lakefront (front row 5-15 m on open lawn) holds for the park. Whether any nightly site is on that row is unresolved: Campspot gives no coordinates and I didn't render its map. Sites P1-P6, 33, 34, 52 and 67 are the ones to place.
SITE LENGTHS: nightly listings seen run 25-50 ft (67 at 25, 34 at 27, P5 at 50); all list Motorhome. 23 ft fits.
SEASON CONFLICT: three statements, written as a note only. See season.note.
